label: VISR 0.6.0
method: benchmark replay frame intervals (immersive stereo, unworn)
resolution: 5009x4018 virtual, 2048x1952 physical per eye (foveated); cutscene frames on a 2396x1350 theater screen
notes: Replays a recorded route (a10-bench / b30-beach-fight) while master-chef idles with no input. Frame-time columns (p50/p95/p99, 1% low) and on_time_pct (frames within 5% of the 90 Hz budget) are the comparison; fps_avg is capped by the display at 90.
